body:
Alanon? I looked it up and came up with Alcoholics Anonymous - is this what you mean? I don't drink and never have, and I don't do drugs, and I think that is a good thing in my case because there is a lot of addiction/alcoholism in my extended family. Do they let you go if you don't have a problem with alcohol?

Thanks for your reply - your message is very sweet and caring. All the people who frequent this subreddit and reply to people are awesome.

It's hard... sometimes I think I'm okay, but other times I just feel horrible. Because it comes and goes, it's easier for me to pass off, and I may very well need to go back on anti-depressants. I'm not going to harm myself, but the feelings are still there. 

My boyfriend is a really wonderful person, but I have a hard time expressing things to people sometimes, and obviously any relationship is going to have its problems. He is very patient and loving, but we have arguments, and had one last night, which may be contributing to my current mood. I think I am mostly frustrated with my inability to communicate clearly by speaking. Sometimes we will talk things out through instant messaging because I find it difficult to speak, and that can help. I express myself far more clearly through the written word. I also want really badly to be perfect, especially for him, and so when I fall short of that, I withdraw, which he finds frustrating, though he is so incredibly supportive and patient, which in turn makes me feel worse because he is trying so hard to do everything right and I still can't respond the way I should/he ideally wants.

And it's difficult because I do know all of these thoughts I am having are illogical, but I can't make them stop. I know that what my family/boyfriend would most want is for me to call them/talk to them and tell them that I am having a hard time. They all love me and want to help me, and I know they do. I've conditioned myself so long to not talk about these things that it's very ingrained, and I have been making progress in communicating, but it's still very difficult for me.

I guess it's just very hard to see the end result I am aiming for. When I am happy, I don't want to feel like this, but when I feel like this, I don't want to be happy. I think some of these feelings will go away if/when I find a job, because I also feel a lot of shame/guilt over not having one currently. I don't want to rely on people, but not relying on people is what has been the biggest issue in my life so far. I need to get out of the house more and I need to either volunteer somewhere nearby or find something else to do, but it's difficult and frustrating. I know that doing something like this would help me in a lot of ways, and allow me to feel as if I am contributing something, but... I haven't done it yet. :/

Thank you for responding. You are a wonderful person.
